name: @suite/document-extraction
description: Source-document ingestion: parsers (docx first) -> IR -> entity extraction (names, dates, pronouns, instruments, score candidates) -> EntityMap. Relocated from the Sped QA Engine repo per D-046: one shared stack, reused by QA for report review and by PsychReport for source-document ingestion (D-077). Instrument libraries are injected by the consumer; this package reads no rulepacks. Distinct from @suite/extraction-core, which turns RIE bank responses into Evidence.
